To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>; ap@redwood.inference
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup: PO routing & payment terms

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the quick intake form — we're excited to get set up with Redwood. A few items from our side as we start the vendor onboarding:

- Preferred PO routing: ap@synergysol.com (please cc my team: accounts-payable@synergysol.com)
- Standard payment terms we work with: Net45, but we can discuss early-pay options if Redwood offers incentives
- Attached: completed W9 and an example invoice (Sample_Invoice_001.pdf)

Two quick questions:
1) Will Redwood accept invoices routed to ap@redwood.inference or do we need to submit via a vendor portal?
2) Do you support an early-pay program (2/10, Net30 or similar)? If so, what are the mechanics to enroll and how are approvals triggered?

If easier, we can hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neil
Head of Finance Operations
Synergy Solutions

Attachment: Sample_Invoice_001.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: PO routing & payment terms

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the materials. Quick answers up front:
- Invoices: we prefer AP invoices sent to invoices@redwood.inference and PO acknowledgements to be returned to ops-ack@redwood.inference; we'll ensure your AP address is added to the PO routing map so your AP gets a copy.
- Early-pay program: Redwood runs a pilot-style accelerated remit program. Common path is 2% if paid within 10 days on Net30 invoices (2/10 Net30), but we can be flexible on the incentive and pilot duration. There is an enrollment step with Finance and a short approval checklist (tax docs, payment routing confirmation, invoice format).

Next steps I propose:
1) Please fill and return our vendor onboarding form (fillable PDF attached) — this lets us map your remit-to and tax info into our ERP.
2) Confirm which PO contact to show on the PO field (ops-contact vs accounts-payable).
3) Tell us whether you want to opt into the accelerated remit pilot. If yes, indicate target discount (e.g., 2%/10 or 1.5%/10) and how many invoices you'd like included in the initial pilot (we typically start with 2–3 invoices).

Kimberly — can you drop the vendor onboarding PDF and the PO template to Liam and flag the account for accelerated-remit evaluation if they opt in?

Liam — I attached the fillable onboarding form (Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Fillable.pdf). If you prefer a call, I'm available 2–3pm PT today.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Fillable.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@synergysol.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: accounts-payable@synergysol.com
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: PO routing & payment terms

Thanks Marcus — attached is the completed onboarding PDF and a short DocuSign link for our vendor agreement. We're willing to trial an accelerated remit program but prefer to keep our standard sales terms as Net45 for catalog orders. For the pilot, we'd be comfortable with a 1% discount if Redwood pays within 10 days for the first three invoices while we confirm process compatibility.

Key notes:
- Onboarding form: completed and attached.
- AP contact for PO acknowledgement: invoiceops@synergysol.com (please cc accounts-payable@synergysol.com on the PO)
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456 (vendor agreement)

If you can confirm the enrollment path and the internal approval owner for an accelerated remit pilot, we'll sign the DocuSign and proceed.

Cheers,
Liam

Liam —

Appreciate the quick turn. We reviewed the completed onboarding form and DocuSign link. Confirming Redwood next steps and what we'll commit to for the pilot:

1) PO routing: We'll map invoiceops@synergysol.com as the acknowledgement contact and ensure your accounts-payable alias is cc'd on PO notifications. Final PO will be sent from ops-ack@redwood.inference.
2) Payment terms: We'll set account default to Net45 per your request.
3) Accelerated remit pilot: Approved for an initial 3-invoice pilot with a 1% discount if invoices are paid within 10 days (1%/10). This pilot will be managed by Finance (Kimberly is the approver and will enable accelerated remit rules in the AP system). After the pilot, we'll re-evaluate discount level and standard terms.

Kimberly — please confirm when accelerated remit is enabled and advise if Finance needs any additional tax or banking verification documents. Karthik — please update the vendor master with the PO contact mapping once Finance confirms.

Liam — once Kimberly confirms, we'll issue the first PO (PO-REDW-0004832) and copy your AP team. Welcome aboard — looking forward to a smooth activation.

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
